text:
I’ll inspect the repository structure and its public-facing metadata, routing, content, and rendering paths, then map concrete SEO/GEO issues to exact files and lines.

The main gaps are concentrated in crawl directives, route metadata, renderability of content, and machine-readable page signals. I’m checking line-level context and package/build conventions now so the findings distinguish definite defects from optional improvements.

## SEO/GEO audit

| Severity | File / lines | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **High** | `public/robots.txt:5-9` | `Bingbot` and `GPTBot` are fully blocked, preventing Bing/Copilot and GPT-based crawlers from discovering the site. This contradicts `geo.config.json:1`, which says AI search crawlers are allowed. | Allow intended search crawlers. Keep training crawlers blocked only if that is the policy. |
| **High** | `geo.config.json:1` | This AI-crawler policy is not wired to any visible application or deployment logic; `robots.txt` implements the opposite policy. | Generate or maintain `robots.txt` from one authoritative policy, and verify deployment consumes this config. |
| **High** | `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` | Pricing has no route-specific title, description, or canonical URL. It inherits generic root metadata. | Add a descriptive title, meta description, and canonical URL. |
| **High** | `app/root.tsx:2`, `app/routes/_index.tsx:2` | Root and home both emit `<title>` and description metadata. Remix will render metadata from both matched routes, potentially producing duplicate titles/descriptions. | Keep site-wide defaults in the root, but make route metadata replace or selectively compose them rather than emitting duplicate tags. |
| **High** | `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5-6` | Changelog entries are fetched only in `useEffect`; the server-rendered HTML contains an empty list. Search engines and AI crawlers may see no release content. | Load entries in a Remix `loader` and render them server-side. Add dates, version headings, and stable entry URLs where appropriate. |
| **Medium** | `app/root.tsx:6` | No Open Graph or Twitter/X metadata is defined, reducing link-preview quality and social/AI context extraction. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:type`, `og:image`, and Twitter card metadata, preferably per route. |
| **Medium** | `app/root.tsx:6` | No Schema.org structured data is emitted. There is no Organization, SoftwareApplication/Product, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, or Article/TechArticle markup. | Add JSON-LD for the organization/product and appropriate route-specific entities; add Article/TechArticle data to changelog entries. |
| **Medium** | `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` | The primary internal CTA is a clickable `<div>`, not a crawlable link. It is also not keyboard-accessible and depends on JavaScript. | Replace it with Remix `<Link to="/features">See all features</Link>`. |
| **Medium** | `app/root.tsx:7`, `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` | The features page is not linked from the global navigation, and the only home-page link is JavaScript-dependent. This weakens internal discovery and topical relationships. | Add semantic navigation links to Home, Features, Pricing, and Changelog. |
| **Medium** | `public/robots.txt:1-9` | `robots.txt` does not advertise the sitemap, making discovery less explicit. | Add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`. |
| **Medium** | `public/sitemap.xml:3-6` | The sitemap is a hand-maintained static list with no `lastmod` values and no clear generation mechanism. It can become stale as routes/content change. | Generate it from the route/content source and include accurate `lastmod` values for changing pages. |
| **Low** | `app/routes/_index.tsx:7-8`, `app/routes/features.tsx:2`, `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`, `app/routes/changelog.tsx:6` | Public pages contain very little explanatory, answer-oriented content. AI systems have few concrete facts to quote about capabilities, audience, use cases, pricing, or product identity. | Add substantive sections with explicit questions/answers, use cases, feature details, pricing expectations, product/company identity, and supporting evidence. |
| **Low** | `app/routes/changelog.tsx:6` | Changelog entries are plain list items without dates, version labels, headings, or structured release metadata. | Render semantic release sections with `<time>`, version headings, summaries, and stable identifiers. |

**Highest-priority fixes:** unblock the intended search/AI crawlers, fix pricing metadata and duplicate root metadata, server-render changelog content, replace the clickable `<div>` with a real link, and add JSON-LD plus Open Graph metadata.
